_comment: Exact source text to the key it should mint under, consulted before the
audit's four-word generator. Two things it is for.
COLLISIONS. A row label and its confirmation dialog differ only by a
question mark, which the generator strips, so both land on one key and
neither can be minted. The dialog gets its own name here rather than the
copy being reworded to satisfy a tool.
WRONG MATCHES. A string whose generated key is already taken by different
English, where the answer is a second key rather than overwriting the
Match is on the DECODED text, after Dart escapes are resolved.
